targets.query:
from(bucket: "veeam")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "veeam_job")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status_code")
  |> count()
  |> yield(name: "total")

from(bucket: "veeam")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "veeam_job")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.last_result == "Success")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status_code")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "veeam")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "veeam_job")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.last_result == "Warning")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status_code")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "veeam")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "veeam_job")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.last_result == "Failed")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status_code")
  |> count()

from(bucket: "veeam")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "veeam_job")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status_code")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["job_name", "job_type", "last_result", "_value", "_time"])

from(bucket: "veeam")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "veeam_repository")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "used_percent")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["repo_name"])

panels.title: Lịch sử Session theo thời gian

targets.query:
from(bucket: "veeam")
  |> range(start: -24h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "veeam_session")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "status_code")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
